image_description: An underwater shot of a hammerhead shark swimming diagonally from the upper left towards the lower right. The shark is silhouetted against the lighter blue surface water above. Its distinctive T-shaped cephalofoil (hammer head) is clearly visible, with eyes at the tips. The body is streamlined with visible dorsal and pectoral fins. In the background, faint outlines of other marine life or divers are visible in the distance.
